Weakness.Name: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts
Weakness.Description: The product does not implement sufficient measures to prevent multiple failed authentication attempts within a short time frame.

Weakness.Name: Improper Control of Interaction Frequency
Weakness.Description: The product does not properly limit the number of interactions it performs with an actor.

Weakness.Name: Insufficient Control Flow Management
Weakness.Description: The code does not sufficiently manage its control flow during execution.

Weakness.Name: Unverified Password Change
Weakness.Description: When setting a new password, the product does not require knowledge of the original password.

Weakness.Name: DEPRECATED: Failure to Protect Stored Data from Modification
